title: Genesis 1:1 stars: ten black hexagons around three coloured stars of David
summary: Under the reference Genesis 1:1, a snowflake-like shape combines ten black hexagon-shaped clusters of small stars with three overlapping six-pointed stars in blue, gold and red - the same shapes used in the previous slides for the odd and even words.

pictures.description: A snowflake-shaped arrangement of tiny stars: ten black hexagon clusters surround and overlap three larger six-pointed stars coloured blue (upper left), gold (right) and red (lower left).
